title: Produce chips component audit sheet
description: Audit the chips filter as an individual button-like option component with selected-state, wrap, density, and responsive contracts.
objective: Define chips as a first-class filter type with its own anatomy, visual affordances, states, layout behavior, and Elementor controls backlog.
acceptance_criteria: Chip label, selected state, hover, focus, disabled, wrap behavior, spacing, density, and optional visuals are treated as separate subelements.
Chips are treated as button-like options, not as generic checkboxes with different CSS.
Responsive wrapping and compact modes are documented.
The audit does not implement chips fixes yet.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: chips render, option parser, option CSS, frontend JS

risks: Chips can look clickable but fail to communicate selected state clearly.
Wrapping behavior can break dense Elementor layouts if not audited.
